author: Ray Leathern
title: Friday PowerBall jackpot now sits at R112 million
text:
How much is the Friday PowerBall jackpot on 21 August 2026 worth? Well, following another round of rollovers this past Tuesday, R112 million is the total pot.
The straight, non-cascading PowerBall is playing for R95 million . And PowerBall XTRA tags on an additional R17 million . Combined, this adds up to a R10-million bump over the winless rolls midweek …
Crucial to game mechanics for the 21 August 2026 Friday PowerBall jackpot is knowing how many rollovers have occurred since the last big payout. In the case of PowerBall, the last big win took place nearly six-and-a-half weeks ago, on Tuesday 3 July 2026 , when R72 million paid out. Since then, it has been thirteen successive rollovers on PowerBall.
And PowerBall XTRA’s last cascade took place on Friday 31 July 2026 . However, it was a relatively small one, and there have been five rollovers since then. The final PowerBall XTRA game of each month MUST payout, no matter what. Players can only hope that this jackpot keeps climbing to a high-digit figure before it does …
FRIDAY POWERBALL JACKPOT 21 AUGUST 2026 AT R112 MILLION Thirteen rollovers has created some excitement again in the PowerBall jackpot this Friday. Image: File Nevertheless, there’s no trick to beat a random lotto draw. However, counting the number of rollovers does let you know when to play the game for the best odds of a split jackpot. New operator Sizekhaya doesn’t want massive winnings rolling over for more than one month . Therefore, being twice weekly, that equates to every eight games for PowerBall XTRA (but not outright PowerBall). Tuesday 21 August is game six of eight for the month.
Of course, every number combination carries identical odds, no matter if you choose an automated Quick Pick or the numbers manually. While neither approach shifts the underlying math, do remember that picking relatives’ birth days is less effective, because they only go to 31 instead of 50 .
PLAY TO WIN FRIDAY POWERBALL JACKPOT 21 AUGUST 2026 For first-time players, Friday PowerBall jackpot involves choosing five main numbers from 1 to 50 , plus one PowerBall number drawn from 1 to 16 . While PowerBall XTRA is an optional second draw using the same numbers entered in the main game. This comes for an extra fee, of course. Pricing has jumped since 1 June 2026 . A standard PowerBall board now costs R10 and PowerBall XTRA costs R5 per board. Therefore, playing both together costs R15 total.
Tickets are sold at authorised National Lottery retailers . You can also enter via participating banking apps, including FNB, Capitec, Standard Bank, ABSA and Nedbank. The largest percentage of winners do come from the banking apps, purely due to the ease and convenience of the medium. However, note that some banking apps force a minimum purchase of two boards per ticket, effectively doubling the entry cost. Players must be 18 years of age or older to enter.
WHAT ARE THE ODDS FOR FRIDAY POWERBALL JACKPOT? The chances of split jackpot for PowerBall XTRA grow exponentially on the eighth game of the month. Image: File Here’s the good news, by shrinking the number pool, the jackpot odds for Friday PowerBall jackpot have improved from 1 in 42 million , to 1 in 33 million . And PowerBall XTRA carries identical odds to the main draw, since it uses the same number matrix. Of course, the big change to your odds is the cascading-jackpot rule.
If nobody matches all the numbers in the final draw of the calendar month, as mentioned, the jackpot for PowerBall XTRA drops down. It goes as far down as required to ensure a guaranteed payout, with winners sharing the pot as needed through a split jackpot . R139 million was split three ways on Tuesday 30 June 2026 using this system. However, that’s still small potatoes compared with the record payout back in February 2019, when a Cape Town man collected R232 million after 24 consecutive rollovers.
DRAW TIMES AND CLAIMING POWERBALL WINNINGS PowerBall and PowerBall XTRA draw every Tuesday and Tuesday at 21:00 . Sizekhaya brought back live televised draws using physical draw machines. Ticket sales cut off before the draw typically at 20:30 , half an hour before the draw. All PowerBall prizes must be claimed within 365 days of the draw date. Anyone who misses that window forfeits their prize and the money is transferred to the National Lottery Distribution Trust for charitable causes.
How and where to claim Friday PowerBall jackpot winnings depends on the amount won:
Small prizes (up to R4 999 ) get paid out directly at licensed retailers. Mid-tier prizes ( R5 000 to R49 999 ) can be claimed at selected partner banks. Online and banking-app players have prizes up to R249 999 deposited automatically into their accounts. And anything above R49 999 (none banking app) requires an in-person visit to a Sizekhaya regional office, with the original ticket and a valid South African ID. CONTACT SIZEKHAYA FOR WINNINGS Contact Sizekhaya for any valid winnings from the last 365 days. Image: File Anyone unsure where to start can call the Sizekhaya helpline on 0861 026 000 . Or you can visit one of the eight regional offices nationally:
Head Office/Gauteng at 36 Homestead Road, Edenburg, Sandton KwaZulu-Natal at 10 Rydall Vale Crescent, Umhlanga Ridge Western Cape at 1st Floor, The Barracks, 50 Bree Street, Cape Town Eastern Cape at 153 Cape Road, Newton Park, Port Elizabeth Free State and Northern Cape at 3 Barnes Street, Arboretum, Bloemfontein Limpopo at Gateway Park, Polokwane Mpumalanga at 29@Marloth, Nelspruit And one final note, around R257 million in lottery prizes currently sits unclaimed across South Africa from the previous operator. Therefore, checking old ticket numbers against those drawn (up to one year ago) costs you nothing and might just turn up forgotten money. You can do so by clicking past results HERE .
